notes.title: New Major Update
notes.notes:
The new build now includes many many improvements. Here is a list of some of these:

[list]
[*] [h3]New cartoon shader[/h3]
With the new shaders, pandas are cuter now!
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]New infrastructures[/h3]
There were too few buildings, but now, you have buildings of different styles: traditional, modern, or sci-fi. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]New weapons and animations[/h3]
Combat became more interesting with a new variety of weapons and animations.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Improved enemy and panda's AI[/h3]
More intelligent AI. Now, it is a real challenge!
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Better visuals[/h3]
Colorful graphics with a new changing environment. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] [h3]Better optimization[/h3]
Bug fixes and improved performance. 
[/list]
